title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Health and Nutrition programme will work in Takhar and Badakhshan provinces, Afghanistan, directly targeting 16,515 people and an additional 44,500, indirectly. The goal of the grant is to contribute to reducing maternal, infant and child morbidity and mortality and improving the overall wellbeing of women of reproductive age and children under the age of five. The programme will do this through integrated health and nutrition, improving access to basic health and nutrition services.. Capacity building 1: Family Health Action Groups established and receive training. Gender 1: pregnant and lactating women are a main target group of this outcome. RMNC Health 2 / Nutrition 2: This outcome focuses on strengthened Community-Based Health Services for Children and pregnant and lactating Women
